name: Paul Citarella
abstract_title: Quantifying Higher States of Consciousness: EEG Signatures, Burst Dynamics, and an AI-Derived Universal Consciousness Index in Monroe Focus-Level Training
abstract: Over five decades, participants in the Monroe Institute’s Gateway Voyage program have reported consistent transitions into a sequence of altered states known as Focus Levels 10, 12, 15, and 21. Although widely cited within transpersonal and contemplative traditions, these states have never been characterized at scale using modern neurophysiological methods.
